title: Post-Round Survey
subtitle: You have completed both rounds. Please answer a few questions before continuing.

questions.text: I feel confident in my ability to negotiate effectively.
I believe I could handle a similar negotiation successfully.
I have a clear understanding of what I did well in this negotiation.
I understand what I should do differently next time.
I understand why I got the outcome I did.

questions_transfer.text: I felt more confident in the second negotiation than the first.
I applied what I learned from the first round.
I had a clearer strategy in the second negotiation.
I handled the second negotiation more effectively.

timing_note: Fires immediately after Round 2. Combines S4 efficacy/insight (primary DVs, identical to S2) with S5 transfer items — all stored together under type s4_efficacy. S4 vs S5 items are distinguished by q vs t prefix in question IDs.
note: ⚠️ S4 questions (q1–q5) intentionally identical to S2. Do not change q-questions independently — both must stay in sync.
